name: Comal County, TX
findings: Comal County has 579 nonprofit organizations. 230 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 188 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Comal County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Comal County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few education organizations list membership
observations.text: 7 education organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 15 would.

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 43 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
